record.charter_text: Article 1 - Spending: no single proposal may allocate more than 50,000 GEN from the treasury in one quarter. Article 2 - Procedure: every proposal must be discussed for at least 7 days and receive votes from at least 60% of voting members before execution. Article 3 - Self-dealing: no proposal may direct treasury funds to its own author or to an entity the author controls. Article 4 - Membership: only members in good standing may author proposals; suspended members may not author proposals.
record.proposal_text: Allocate 80,000 GEN from the treasury to an independent community auditor for the annual treasury audit. The proposal was discussed for 10 days and received votes from 71% of voting members. The author receives no funds.
record.summary: Checked Article 1 spending, Article 2 procedure, Article 3 self-dealing, and Article 4 membership. The proposal violates Article 1 because it allocates 80,000 GEN, exceeding the 50,000 GEN single-proposal quarterly cap.
record.title: Annual treasury audit grant

record.proposal_text: Allocate 20,000 GEN from the treasury to fund the Q4 community grants round. The proposal was discussed for 10 days and received votes from 72% of voting members. The author receives no funds and holds no interest in any recipient.

record.title: Q4 community grants round
